target_id.description: Exact id of who here died.

name: leave_party
description: Make a party member stop travelling with the player.

target_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

name: direct
description: End the turn and give notes to the narrator. Call this last, once per turn. Include the answer or result, its known reason, and facts needed for the next choice. Share only facts the player can know now. Apply world changes through the other tools before calling direct.

text.description: Brief factual notes for the narrator to phrase. Answer each question in the player action. Include the result, its known reason, and details needed for the next choice. For a request or warning, give what the person wants and the reason they share. Use facts the player can know now. Identify claims and unknown reasons as such. Keep every outcome consistent with tool results.

name: reveal
description: Make a hidden entity here known to the player. HIDDEN HERE lists what the player has not found: call this before you tell a hidden thing.

target_id.description: Exact id of something hidden here.

name: move_item
description: Move an item to a new holder.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item here or carried.

holder_id.description: Exact id of the player, an npc here, or this place.

name: unlock_way
description: Open a locked way out of this place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the locked way's destination.

name: move
description: Move the player through an unlocked way out of this place. While the rival waits here to battle, the engine refuses every way but the one back to the place the player came from; before the first move, it refuses every way.

to_id.description: Exact id of the place to move to.

with_ids.description: Exact ids of living npcs here who follow one time. Party members come without this field.

name: meanwhile
description: Pass time where the player is not: move a dweller, move a loose item, and shut a way the player knows. Use any combination in one call. Call this only while ELSEWHERE is shown.

dweller_id.description: Exact id of a dweller elsewhere who walks to a new place.

dweller_to_id.description: Exact id of the place the dweller walks to.

item_id.description: Exact id of a loose item elsewhere that moves to a new place.

item_to_id.description: Exact id of the place the item moves to.

shut_from_id.description: Exact id of one end of the way that shuts.

shut_to_id.description: Exact id of the other end of the way that shuts.

name: join_party
description: Make a person here travel with the player.

target_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.

name: check
description: Roll a check when the player tries something hard outside a battle. The engine rolls d20, adds twice the skill rank and 2 to 4 for a helping Pokemon by its friendship, and compares the total with the difficulty. A success earns the edge the attempt aims for. You decide what a failure costs.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

difficulty.description: easy is DC 10, hard is DC 15, very-hard is DC 20.

helper_mon_id.description: Exact id of a team Pokemon that helps. It must not be fainted. Null when none helps.

reason.description: How the helper helps, such as 'Geodude breaks the rock'. The player reads it. Empty with no helper.

edge.description: The edge the attempt aims for in the next battle here, such as foe-asleep for a Stealth ambush or bait for a Nature trap. A success earns it. Null for none.

name: heal_team
description: Heal the whole team and the box: HP, PP and status. Only in a town: the engine refuses anywhere else.

name: nickname
description: Name a Pokemon of the team or the box as the player chose.

mon_id.description: Exact id of the team or box Pokemon the player names.

name.description: The nickname: 1 to 12 letters, digits, spaces, ' or -. Not a species name, and not the name of another of the player's Pokemon.

name: buy
description: Buy items for the player at their price. Only in a town: the engine refuses anywhere else.

item_id.description: Exact id of the item. A TM is tm-<move id>, such as tm-thunderbolt.

name: gain_item
description: Give the player items they find or get for free.

item_id.description: Exact id of the item. A TM is tm-<move id>, such as tm-thunderbolt.

name: gain_money
description: Give the player money, such as a reward.

name: use_item
description: Use a potion, a super potion, a full heal, a revive, a Rare Candy, a stone, another evolution item or a Linking Cord on a team Pokemon, outside a battle.

mon_id.description: Exact id of the team Pokemon it is used on.

name: swap_mon
description: Swap a team Pokemon with one in the box. The player can do this anywhere from the Team page.

team_mon_id.description: Exact id of the team Pokemon that goes to the box.

box_mon_id.description: Exact id of the box Pokemon that joins the team.

name: start_battle
description: Start a battle when a trainer here and the player agree to one. The battle screen plays the fight, and the engine applies the result. Call it last: it ends your turn. A trainer battles once per visit. A gym leader never battles again once beaten. The rival battles once before the first badge, then once after each badge. A double trainer battles two-on-two, and the player needs two Pokemon that can fight. In a tag battle, the first party member with a team fights beside the player, two-on-two; the player then needs one Pokemon that can fight. A legendary Pokemon here battles alone as a wild Pokemon, never in a tag battle.

trainer_id.description: Exact id of the trainer here who battles the player.

weather.description: The weather of the battle, from the story: rain for a storm, sun for a sunny beach, sand for a desert, snow for a snowfield. It lasts the whole battle. Null for none.

terrain.description: The terrain of the battle, from the story: electric for a power plant, grassy for a meadow, misty for a foggy marsh, psychic for a strange place. It lasts the whole battle. Null for none.

tag.description: True for a tag battle: the first party member with a team fights beside the player, two-on-two. The trainer needs two Pokemon or more.

name: start_wild_battle
description: Start a battle when the player meets a wild Pokemon here, such as in tall grass. Set `species_id` to one from WILD HERE, or leave it null to roll on the table; in a Nuzlocke, always leave it null. Call it last: it ends your turn.

species_id.description: A species id from WILD HERE. Null lets the engine roll on the table. Always null in a Nuzlocke.

weather.description: The weather of the battle, from the story: rain for a storm, sun for a sunny beach, sand for a desert, snow for a snowfield. It lasts the whole battle. Null for none.

terrain.description: The terrain of the battle, from the story: electric for a power plant, grassy for a meadow, misty for a foggy marsh, psychic for a strange place. It lasts the whole battle. Null for none.
